_note: Staff-roll (ENDING.PRG) letters the English credits never draw. The staff roll draws byte c with cell c - 0x20 of its font (ENDING.PRG D4.c, _renderText); each cell is a glyph of the same set, so the Ukrainian letter takes the byte of a cell whose English character the credits do not use. Latin look-alikes (А В Е І К М Н О Р С Т Х and a e i o p c y x) keep their Latin cell (translation_map.json). Spare: 0x39 '9' and 0x71 'q'.
